# Vendored Agent Skill provenance

This directory contains third-party Agent Skill snapshots kept separate from
the project-authored [skills](../../skills/). They are not installed by the
repository and are not part of the supported evidence-export runtime.

## Scientific Agent Skills

The following directories originate from the MIT-licensed
[`K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills`](https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills)
project:

- `scholar-evaluation/`
- `scientific-brainstorming/`
- `scientific-critical-thinking/`
- `scientific-schematics/`
- `scientific-slides/`
- `scientific-visualization/`
- `scientific-writing/`

## AI Skill Scholar

The following directories originate from the MIT-licensed
[`dsebastien/ai-skill-scholar`](https://github.com/dsebastien/ai-skill-scholar)
project:

- `literature-review/`
- `scholar-citations/`
- `scholar-search/`

Exact upstream revisions are not recorded for either group. Review each
snapshot's metadata, instructions, and license before use or redistribution.
The machine-readable mapping is in [provenance.json](provenance.json);
project-wide license context is in
[THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
